reason: Pytest confirms the added case-insensitive test fails because parse_enum compares the trimmed token directly against allowed entries without case-insensitive matching.
thoughts: I’ll inspect the patch to verify both ticket requirements and compatibility before deciding.

The implementation trims tokens but compares them case-sensitively, so `parse_enum(" HIGH ", ("Low", "High"))` raises instead of returning the canonical `"High"`. The added test expects that behavior and would fail; Req 1 is unmet.

The PR fails its own case-insensitive test: `parse_enum(" HIGH ", ("Low", "High"))` raises `ValueError` instead of returning the canonical `"High"`. Req 1 is unmet, so merging risks shipping a broken API.
